benefit_text: The scheme pays 3,000 rupees after pregnancy registration and one checkup. The scheme pays 2,000 rupees after birth registration and vaccines till 14 weeks. The scheme pays 6,000 rupees for a second child if it is a girl child.
who_can_apply: Pregnant women must be at least 19 years old. The scheme is for the first live birth and for women with wage loss. Women in regular government jobs cannot apply.
documents: Papers needed are Aadhaar card and bank account details. MCP card and child birth certificate are also needed. Child immunization details are needed after birth.
how_to_apply: Go to the official website of the Ministry and click Citizen login. Enter mobile number for verification and create an account. Then login and fill beneficiary registration for first child or second child.
